newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns AAA rating to Toyota's $1 bln eurobond.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AAA rating to Toyota's $1 bln eurobond.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Wednesday it had assigned its AAA rating to Toyota Motor Corp's $1 billion 6.25 percent euro straight bond due July 22, 2002.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P said in a statement.
Despite intensely competitive industry conditions, Toyota has been able to maintain high profitability, largely reflecting its rigorous cost-cutting programmes, S&P said.
The rating agency expects Toyota to maintain its exceptionally strong financial profile over the next few years, it said.
